about: Phases 9 to 11's hand labels (owner, 15 Nov 2026): every connector site (a read or write and its table, an outside service, a hand-off, a link to the app's API or a mutation run through a hook) in Rallly and Documenso, and in phase 8's fixed modules of LibreChat and Twenty, at the pins. Built by comparing the engine with an independent text scan of the same files, and reading every difference in the code: where the engine was wrong it was fixed (about 20 fixes, each with a test); where the scan was wrong it's noted; what the engine still misses is labelled with why. A site is at its method's line (`.selectFrom`, not the chain's first line). The bar: 100% precision, at least 95% recall per fork, every miss explained.

notes: Every file at the pin, tests aside. The independent scan's other differences, read in the code: setInterval in apps/landing pricing-controls.tsx is a React state setter, not the timer.

chains.name: Phase 9: the Create poll form's submit (CreatePoll, makePoll.mutateAsync) into the tRPC procedure polls.make and its handler

notes: Every file at the pin, tests and packages/ee aside. The independent scan's other differences, read in the code: authClient.account.delete (security.linked-accounts.tsx) is better-auth's client, not Prisma; trpc.admin.stripe.createCustomer (organisations.$id.tsx) is a tRPC procedure named stripe; setInterval in billing-plans.tsx is a state setter; setTimeout(() => resolve(null), …) in utils/timeout.ts only waits.

sites.missed: The email preview app's route (packages/email/preview/app/routes/api.render.tsx) isn't detected as an entry point, so the call has no route to join.
